Original sparse tree groups in the upper-right plain disappear beneath the newly introduced water.
The original dense right-middle grove is largely removed or replaced by a differently arranged coastal slope and vegetation; a small original-looking patch survives near its lower part.
Original isolated left-middle tree clusters are replaced by cultivated plots, paths and differently positioned vegetation.
Original scattered foreground trees west of the rectangular plots are removed or replaced by pasture, animals and new boundaries.
Original broad field and scrub parcels in the central middle ground are erased or reshaped by the new shoreline, paths and developed land.
The original faint curved track in the right foreground is replaced by a differently positioned winding path and shelter compound.

The populated-looking triangular patch at far right survives as an isolated wedge, but its surrounding original land has been removed, changing it from part of a continuous plain into a peninsula-like remnant.
